linked_prs.title: fix(cli): prioritize configured auth over env vars in non-interactive mode
linked_prs.body:
## TLDR

Fixes authentication precedence in non-interactive mode so that configured settings in `settings.json` take priority over environment variables.

## Dive Deeper

Previously, if environment variables like `GEMINI_API_KEY` were set, they would override any authentication configuration in `settings.json` during non-interactive runs. This change ensures that `configuredAuthType` (from settings) is checked first. `enforcedType` remains a constraint.

## Reviewer Test Plan

1. Login to OAuth.
2. Set `GEMINI_API_KEY` to a different/fake value in the environment.
3. Run a non-interactive command `gemini -p hi`
4. Verify it uses the configured OAuth credentials and not the API key from the environment.
5. Unset auth in settings, keep the environment variable, run again, and verify it uses the environment variable.

## Testing Matrix

|          | 🍏  | 🪟  | 🐧  |
| -------- | --- | --- | --- |
| npm run  | ✅  | ❓  | ❓ |
| npx      | ✅  | ❓  | ❓  |
| Docker   | ❓  | ❓  | ❓  |
| Podman   | ❓  | -   | -   |
| Seatbelt | ❓  | -   | -   |

## Linked issues / bugs
Fixes #10933
